units.source_text: 家家户户的房檐直伸出去，支撑着它一端的柱子并排立在街道上。

en.t: The eaves of every house stretched straight out, and the pillars supporting their outer edges stood in rows along the street.

units.source_text: 好像江户城里叫“店下”的廊檐，在这雪国旧时把它叫“雁木”。

en.t: It was like the covered eaves called tanashita in Edo, but in this snow country they had long called it gangi.

units.source_text: 积雪太厚时，这廊檐就成为往来的通道。

en.t: When the snow lay too deep, these eaves became a passageway for coming and going.

units.source_text: 通道一侧，房屋整齐，廊檐也就连接下去。

en.t: On one side of the passage, the houses stood in orderly rows, so the covered eaves continued on.
